hallways.scope: Every hallway on both wings of House 55: L, W, A-B-C-D and the subsequently checked opposite wing.
hallways.measurementFacesInterpretation: Treat as clear finished-wall-to-finished-wall hallway width. This conventional interpretation was stated by the assistant; exact endpoints have not separately been confirmed by the resident.

sourceEvidence.text: I can also tell you with fact that EVERY hallway in the "L", "W", and "A-B-C-D" side of the dorm measure 130cm wide.
sourceEvidence.subsequentConfirmation: ok so we know the size of the hallways (I also checked the other wing and they were also 130cm wide)

distinctions: The resident subsequently measured the other wing and confirmed the same 1.30 m width.
The staircase's independently confirmed level walkway is 1.29 m; do not round that observation into this 1.30 m record.
Corridor runs, turning junctions and end pockets have not yet been individually registered to source-model edges.
Wall thickness, hallway length and apartment depth do not follow from this width alone.
